evidence: research/probe4 and S1 notes; README residual risks

decision: sandboxed commands reach github.com, *.github.com, *.githubusercontent.com, the npm and Yarn registries, PyPI and crates.io without review; another host needs a re-run with allowed_domains, which the gate holds on unattended turns (net.hosts row, hosts on the card, in the fingerprint)

decision: a live query with no turn closes after 15 idle minutes (the reaper); the next turn resumes the session on a new process

decision: push goes out only while no socket is live (heard from within 45 s); the server pings a socket silent for 44 s

decision: the lock records the holder's start in UTC and still matches an older local-time lock; a live holder whose start ps cannot read is busy; the before-boot rule applies only to a lock with no recorded start
